Tokuyama.why: makes semiconductor-grade polycrystalline silicon, the raw material for silicon wafers, plus high-purity IPA for chip fabs, so its electronic-materials earnings track wafer and fab volumes
Tokuyama.evidence: Tokuyama results presentation 07-29-2026: Electronic & Advanced Materials segment covers semiconductor-grade polycrystalline silicon and high-purity IPA for electronic manufacturing; polycrystalline silicon factory under construction in Vietnam

players.product: semiconductor-grade polycrystalline silicon; high-purity isopropyl alcohol (IPA) for electronics manufacturing

quarterly_data.quarter: Tokuyama results presentation: Presentation for IR Meeting Q1 Fiscal 2026 (07-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Q1 FY2026 (April-June 2026) results: net sales JPY 85.6 billion (+5%), operating profit JPY 6.0 billion (-23%), helped by firm sales of semiconductor-related products and hurt by lower chemicals sales and higher raw material and fuel prices. Electronic & Advanced Materials segment: net sales JPY 22.3 billion, operating profit JPY 3.1 billion (+11%). Semiconductor-grade polycrystalline silicon: sales volume decreased year on year but earnings grew, helped by a smaller loss on valuation of inventories. IC chemicals: sales volumes of high-purity isopropyl alcohol for electronic manufacturing increased but earnings fell on higher raw material costs. Thermal management materials: earnings rose on robust volumes for semiconductor production equipment applications.
quarterly_data.figure: Net sales JPY 85.6 billion (+5%); operating profit JPY 6.0 billion (-23%); Electronic & Advanced Materials sales JPY 22.3 billion, OP JPY 3.1 billion (+11%)

quarterly_data.quarter: Tokuyama results presentation: Presentation for IR Meeting Q1 Fiscal 2026 (07-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: FY2026 (year ending March 2027) forecast: net sales JPY 392.0 billion (+12%), operating profit JPY 34.0 billion (-8%); Electronic & Advanced Materials net sales JPY 106.5 billion (+16%), operating profit JPY 16.0 billion. The company says that while the semiconductor wafer market has entered a period of stagnation, cutting-edge fields remain robust and the number of manufacturing processes is increasing as technology advances; general-purpose and legacy segments show a weak recovery while Chinese manufacturers gain presence; it expects the semiconductor market to see growing demand over the medium to long term, driven by the boom in AI data centers.

quarterly_data.quarter: Tokuyama results presentation: Presentation for IR Meeting Q1 Fiscal 2026 (07-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Investment plan FY2026: capital expenditures JPY 46.1 billion (FY2025: JPY 32.7 billion). Major growth projects: construction of the factory in Vietnam for polycrystalline silicon (ongoing), a new recycling facility at FTAC for high-purity IPA (ongoing), and a second plant at FTAC for high-purity IPA (new project).
